title: Avoid null pointer exceptions
content: An object is dereferenced without first checking whether it is null, which raises a NullPointerException.

title: SQL injection risk
content: Building a SQL query by concatenating strings leaves the code open to SQL injection.

title: Unclosed resource causes a leak
content: An IO stream, database connection or similar resource is opened but not closed when an exception occurs, leaking the resource.

title: Incorrect use of a concurrent collection
content: Using HashMap instead of ConcurrentHashMap in a multi-threaded context can cause an infinite loop or lost writes.
